source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative filename LF sorted by filename; receipt and validation outputs excluded
API: plan_write(values, *, wire_profile, address, allocation) -> frozen WritePlan
WritePlan.metadata() -> fresh JSON-compatible dict without payload

ABI_binding.note: Constants are derived layout facts; no upstream serializer implementation copied. No new C compilation or kernel execution in this task.

validation.test_scope: Original synthetic source values only; no raw saved BootArgs or captured device values read by tests. Mutants compile, then their specified test has an assertion failure and no ERROR; syntax/import exceptions do not count.

checked_guards: Explicit exact external wire profile required on encode/decode/plan; never infer layout from Revision2 alone or length/fallback.
Exact plain dictionaries and field sets; exact unsigned integer widths and bool/type rejection; all common/video/flags/actual-size values retained without input mutation.
Zero-initialized deterministic1152 payload; reserved padding zero; command preserves every ASCII byte except embedded NUL, at most1023 bytes plus NUL, no strip/rewrite.
Decoder exact immutable bytes/length/profile/R2V2; reserved zero padding, ASCII through first NUL and all-zero remaining command bytes. No hidden legacy tail reads.

Pure plan uses only supplied exact reviewed-allocation dict and explicit values, checks u64 nonwrap/nonempty/alignment/full containment, returns frozen bytes/address/extent/hash metadata. It neither proves allocation review/RAM ownership nor accepts a backend/proxy/writer.
known_ambiguity: An all-zero-tail legacy736 serialization padded to1152 can equal a canonical native payload. No binary parser can distinguish identical bytes; the mandatory external producer/profile binding carries provenance. Historical profiles/captures are not relabeled.
separate_integration_required: No live host, m1n1 module, legacy serializer/capture or controller was modified. This leaf is not used by any current boot.

A separately reviewed opt-in isolated host integration must use the codec at the final BootArgs rewrite and prove every later HV/start writer preserves it rather than reverting to revision-indexed r2.
Exact final guest BootArgs wire bytes/profile/hash and reviewed allocation binding must be saved after last write and before a future boot. No actual write or boot is authorized here.
next_step: Independent frozen-source review only; subsequent isolated host integration remains a separate task.
